title: 🌤️ Weather Intelligence & Farm Alerts
subtitle: Real-time weather conditions and 5-day forecasts for your farm location
humidityAlertDesc: Humidity above 80% increases fungal disease risk. Consider fungicide application on vulnerable crops.
heatStressDesc: High temperatures may stress crops. Irrigate early morning or evening and provide shade for seedlings.
windAlertDesc: Strong winds can damage standing crops. Check and reinforce trellises and support structures.
irrigationDesc: Current conditions suggest irrigation is needed to maintain optimal soil moisture.
